The system

Six parts. One power station.

Each component does one job brilliantly. Together, they make your building its own power station.

01
01 · Capture

Solar panels

High-output panels from leading manufacturers, with a 30-year product and performance warranty.

02 · Optimise

PV optimisers

Panel-level optimisation so one shaded panel doesn't drag down the whole string.

03 · Convert

Solar inverters

Convert the panels' DC output into AC electricity your building can use, with built-in future-ready technology.

04 · Store

Battery storage

Bank surplus daytime power for the evening, the night and the peak-rate hours.

05 · Drive

EV charging

Smart chargers that prioritise solar power, so your car runs on sunshine.

06 · Control

Energy management

Monitor, control and optimise your whole system from your phone or desktop.

EV charging

Drive on sunshine.

Solar-first smart chargers send surplus power into your car instead of the grid, at home or at work.

Huawei Smart Charger

PV-preferred mode, three-to-single-phase switching down to 1.4 kW, IP54 with lightning protection.

Fronius Wattpilot Flex

Charges from surplus PV with intelligent, plannable modes and an easy app.

Sigen EV AC Charger

Up to 22 kW, drawing from solar, battery and grid for fast, green charging.
